sourceStatusDefinitions.native_platform_reference: Platform-owned design reference, native behavior unchanged.
sourceStatusDefinitions.legacy_foundation_reference: Original surface-helper component retained; canonical paint documentation referenced.
sourceStatusDefinitions.canonical_publication_required: Approved canonical master exists, but its current key is not importable; publish those approved assets before reconnection.

openItems.detail: 12 private new DS candidates await individual review; two compatibility cards show preserved source compositions.
Nine Text Field instances retain their original references because On focus/Filled canonical keys are not published/importable. Do not publish pending candidates.
147 legacy composition instances, mostly headers/navigation and two feature-content panels, remain linked to prevent content or action loss.
Three biometric/share-sheet instances retain native source references; system behavior was not recreated.

applicationChange.scope: Design System gallery, documentation and Inspect only

initialFullVerify.failure: Retired PI UI graph guard: newly reachable legacy HomeHeader and MoreHeader via componentLivePreviews

verification.resolvedRegression: Dormant retired HomeHeader/MoreHeader imports were replaced by existing native preview snapshots in the DS live-preview module. Guards, thresholds and approval hashes were unchanged.
verification.additionalSpecimenCopy: Payment hero and both product accordions now use contextual local specimen descriptions. Native NavigationRow has no existing text override API and retains its source copy.

finalFullVerify.provenance: Complete shared-checkout invocation. All 16 task-owned source/test files predated its start and remained hash-identical through completion.

priorCoverageInterruption.cause: Concurrent verify invocations shared coverage/.tmp; the peer completed coverage and cleaned the directory while this run was writing.

nonBlockingWarnings: React Native Web test animation fallback
Git CRLF normalization notices in existing assets
